title: Yod and its spelled-out letters shown as plus, bar and dot shapes
summary: Shows the letter yod and its spelled-out letters (dalet, vav, yod) above three large plain shapes in matching colours: a brown plus sign, an orange vertical bar and a small red-brown diamond. The slide gives no written explanation of the shapes.

words.gloss: name of the letter yod, spelled out

pictures.description: Large brown plus sign (a cross of equal-length vertical and horizontal bars), matching the brown colour of the letter dalet above.
Tall orange vertical bar, matching the orange colour of the letter vav above.
Small red-brown diamond (dot), matching the colour of the letter yod above.

uncertain: The slide does not label the plus, bar and diamond; their colours match dalet (brown), vav (orange) and yod (red-brown), but their intended meaning is not stated.
